title: Reformat rust Cargo.tomls: multi-line feature arrays + alphabetical dep convention
description: Context: parallel beads workers (7 TUI agents) edit Cargo.toml concurrently and collide on single-line feature arrays — git merges by lines, and 'std = [...]' is one line, so any two agents adding a dep hit the same line (seen live: zeroize vs hex both-added conflict resolved manually in 54e2c2cc5b). Fix: in rust/*/Cargo.toml, reformat [features] arrays (and any long dep arrays) one entry per line, and document/apply the convention that new [dependencies]/[dev-dependencies] entries are inserted alphabetically (appends land at different points instead of section-end collisions). Add a short comment block at the top of each Cargo.toml: 'Swarm note: one feature per line; insert deps alphabetically; keeps parallel agent merges conflict-free. Do not collapse to single-line.' Scope: rust/*.crates only — leave vendor/workspace tomls alone. Verify with cargo metadata/cargo check per touched crate and a clean git merge simulation between two branches that each add a different optional dep.
